claim: A sector open to the sky holds its ceiling at least as high as any roofed neighbour's: otherwise the upper wall is drawn and daylight shows below the surrounding roofline. The campaign holds 73% of such pairs exactly equal with a median gap of zero; the four that go the other way are all in E3M4.
evidence: bloodmap/rules_blood.py rule 'sky-is-never-below-a-roof', counted over the 43 campaign maps; NBlood/source/build/src/engine.cpp:4688 draws the upper wall whenever either side is roofed
use: Run the rule on a built map; a doorway from a room to a yard keeps the yard's sky at or above the room's ceiling.
